scope: internal/broker, internal/gateway: tests of the broker's client door
correction: The client door's tests pulled with nats.go only, whose request mux gives a message of an unknown subject to its single open request; so no test saw that a pulled message keeps its stream subject, and a nats.js client that pulled with request() and its subject-keyed mux got no event. A test of the client door now drives a pull over /nats with the protocol's own lines and checks the delivered subject, the reply and the ack, and the spec tells clients to read a pull on a subscription of their own.
evidence: Pilot run 2026-11-16, line L2: the hub's consumer delivered stream seq 5 17 times with no ack and never delivered seq 6; a reproduction with the bridge's vendored @nats-io/nats-core 3.4.0 over a WebSocket door timed out on every request() pull while the trace showed MSG marks.a 1 $JS.ACK...; the same pull with noMux returned the message
